summary: Pointed Gromov-Hausdorff / Cheeger-Gromov compactness interface. GHConvergenceData is the epsilon-isometry form of pointed GH convergence (distortion, almost surjectivity, basepoint control, error scale tending to zero along an arbitrary filter); GHPrecompactCertificate is the uniform finite-net + completeness certificate for a family of pointed metric spaces. Kernel-checked: distortion and basepoint convergence lemmas, reflexivity, monotonicity in scale and filter, composition with the epsilon1 + 2*epsilon2 bookkeeping; the total-boundedness consequences of the certificate fields (explicit uniform finite nets, total boundedness and compactness of basepoint balls and of arbitrary closed balls, properness, whole-space total boundedness/compactness under a diameter bound); and the toy compactness theorem for finite metric-space families by explicit enumeration (pigeonhole extraction of a constant strictly monotone subsequence, Finset.univ nets with a uniform cardinality bound, GH convergence to the selected member). The full Cheeger-Gromov compactness theorem for Riemannian manifold families is a state-only Prop with an opaque smooth convergence relation and a twelve-entry named missing-input ledger plus five named blockers. No sorry/axiom/unsafe/native_decide/proof_wanted; all 95 audited declarations have standard axiom cones.

main_declarations.PointedMetricSpace: structure { M : Type u, inst : PseudoMetricSpace M, base : M } with CoeSort
main_declarations.GHConvergenceData: structure (l : Filter iota) (X : iota -> PointedMetricSpace) (Y : PointedMetricSpace): eps : iota -> R, 0 <= eps, Tendsto eps l (nhds 0), approx : forall i, X i -> Y, distortion (eps-isometry), surjective (eps-surjectivity), base_dist
main_declarations.GHPrecompactCertificate: structure (X : iota -> PointedMetricSpace): netBound : R -> R -> N, net : forall i, R -> R -> Finset (X i), net_card_le, base_mem_net, net_covers (0 < eps), complete : forall i, CompleteSpace (X i)
main_declarations.GHConvergenceData.comp: GHConvergenceData l (fun _ => Y) Z -> GHConvergenceData l X Y -> GHConvergenceData l X Z with scale eps1 + 2 * eps2
main_declarations.GHPrecompactCertificate.totallyBounded_c: certificate -> forall i R, TotallyBounded (closedBall (X i).base R)
main_declarations.GHPrecompactCertificate.isCompact_closed: certificate -> forall i x r, IsCompact (closedBall x r)
main_declarations.GHPrecompactCertificate.compactSpace_of_: certificate -> uniform diameter bound D -> forall i, CompactSpace (X i)
main_declarations.exists_strictMono_const_of_fin: forall u : N -> Fin n, exists i phi, StrictMono phi and forall k, u (phi k) = i
main_declarations.finiteFamilyCertificate: F : Fin n -> PointedMetricSpace -> [forall i, Fintype (F i)] -> GHPrecompactCertificate F with netBound = max_i #(F i) and net = Finset.univ
main_declarations.toyCompactness_finiteFamily: F : Fin n -> PointedMetricSpace -> [forall i, Fintype (F i)] -> u : N -> Fin n -> exists i phi, StrictMono phi and Nonempty (GHConvergenceData atTop (fun k => F (u (phi k))) (F i))
main_declarations.toyCompactnessData: constructive Sigma form of the toy compactness theorem (index, strictly monotone subsequence, GH data)
main_declarations.missingPointedGHConvergentSubsequence: state-only Prop: forall certificate of X, exists phi and Y with GHConvergenceData atTop (X . phi) Y
main_declarations.missingCheegerGromovCompactness: state-only Prop: ManifoldFamilyHypotheses.noncollapsed -> .harmonicBounds -> exists phi Y, Nonempty (GHConvergenceData atTop (X . phi) Y) and CGConvergesTo (X . phi) Y
main_declarations.cheegerGromov_of_ghPrecompact_and_smooth: certificate -> missingPointedGHConvergentSubsequence X -> uniform smooth upgrade -> missingCheegerGromovCompactness
main_declarations.cheegerGromovConclusion_of_finiteFamily: finite family + smooth relation on the family -> the conclusion of missingCheegerGromovCompactness holds (metric part from the toy theorem)

nonvacuity.model: one-point pointed space (M = PUnit), constant family; Fin n-indexed families of one-point spaces

honest_boundary: No Riemannian manifold, curvature tensor, injectivity radius, harmonic coordinates or elliptic regularity is constructed.
The Cheeger-Gromov smooth convergence relation CGConvergesTo is an opaque parameter, never defined.
missingCheegerGromovCompactness and missingPointedGHConvergentSubsequence are state-only Props, never asserted as theorems.
The metric extraction of a GH-convergent subsequence from the precompactness certificate (the diagonal argument) is not proved; only its finite-family toy case is.
GHConvergenceData is the epsilon-isometry definition of pointed GH convergence; its equivalence with a pointed GH distance and the completeness of the limit are not formalized.
The total-boundedness consequences are conditional on the certificate fields (explicit nets and completeness); no family of genuine manifolds is certified.
The finite-family toy compactness theorem uses finite pigeonhole and explicit Finset.univ enumeration; it is not a compactness theorem for infinite families.
No Ricci flow, surgery, canonical-neighbourhood or Poincare content is claimed.
